name: The Wondrous Wisdomball offers and takes back every Gnomeregan quest tagged to the dungeon, not only the junk, ring and escort quests a creature inside it hands out
contract: AscensionWisdomball.cpp's AreasOfMap(mapId) collects a dungeon's quests from three sources: creature_queststarter, gameobject_queststarter, and quest_template rows whose QuestSortID matches an AreaTable.dbc row whose own mapid equals the dungeon's map. Gnomeregan (map 90) breaks that third source the same way Razorfen Kraul (map 47) does: AreaTable.dbc has exactly one row with mapid 90 (ID 721, 'Gnomeregan'), but none of the dungeon's own story quests use QuestSortID 721 - they use QuestSortID 133, a second AreaTable row also named 'Gnomeregan' whose own mapid is 0. Map.dbc's linked_zone does not tie 721 back to 133 either. AreasOfMap(90) therefore returned only [721], no quest_template row matched it, and LoadDungeonQuests(90) fell back to the two starter tables alone. Those two tables cover only the twelve Gnomeregan quests a creature or game object on map 90 hands out - the escort (2904 A Fine Mess), the ring (2947/2949 Return of the Ring) and the junk redistribution chain (2951 to 2953, 4601 to 4606 The Sparklematic 5200! and More Sparklematic Action) - which is exactly the list the report describes, while every main dungeon quest (2841 Rig Wars, 2842 Chief Engineer Scooty, 2843 Gnomer-gooooone!, 2922 Save Techbot's Brain!, 2929 The Grand Betrayal, and the rest of QuestSortID 133) was silently dropped from the offer list. The fix adds area 133 to AreasOfMap's result specifically for map 90, mirroring the existing Razorfen Kraul entry. The same area also has to reach the list of quests a player carries, which AllDungeonQuests builds for the whole realm by scanning AreaTable for rows whose mapid is a dungeon map: 133 (mapid 0) and every quest it sorts were missing there too, and a carried quest that is not in that list is never handed back by the ball. This scenario proves a Horde character standing in Gnomeregan is offered its Horde-eligible dungeon quests that no creature inside hands out (2841, 2842, 2843) alongside one of the quests that always worked (2951, neutral, started by the Sparklematic 5200 game object), while an Alliance-only dungeon quest (2922 Save Techbot's Brain!) and the Alliance follow-up of the ring chain (2947) stay correctly withheld from a Horde character by the existing race check.
